subject: Cancellation fault matrix across job phases, queues, scheduler and export

coverage.requirement: Stop in every pre-publish RenderJob phase
coverage.mechanism: enter(phase, stop) and cancel() from created/preparing/rendering/finishing

coverage.requirement: Cancel at publish gate keeps old target
coverage.mechanism: stop armed from sink finish(); enter(publishing) cancels; OutputTransaction destructor drops staging

coverage.requirement: Mid-render cancel + late sink callback without UAF
coverage.mechanism: shared LateCallbackContext outlives sink; cancel() joins deferred completion before destructor returns

coverage.requirement: Post-publish cancel must not pretend video is absent
coverage.mechanism: RenderJob::cancel rejected with cancel_after_publish_gate; target file remains

coverage.requirement: Scheduler abort wakes workers and joins cleanly
coverage.mechanism: FrameEvalScheduler::abort request_stop + queue abort; evaluate observes stop_token

coverage.requirement: Bounded queue abort wakes blocked push; stop_callback safe
coverage.mechanism: BoundedQueue::abort + std::stop_callback while queue still alive

coverage.requirement: Process supervisor bounds hung native work
